correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the six 2K jet rows by substituting x+t and y[1−((x+t)^4−x^4)/y^4]^(1/4) into the conic basis and reducing the determinant modulo the Fermat equation. This independently gives the displayed coefficient and factors. In characteristic at least 11 the row factorials and 22680 are units, so this tests conic contact by ordinary jets; the determinant is generically nonzero. With y nonzero, x is a parameter, and the three noncoordinate root conditions reduce to x^4 in {−1/2,1,−2}, distinct and nonzero. The 48 proper zeros are simple; symmetry gives the twelve weight-five coordinate hyperflexes, confirmed also by the local fourth-order coordinate tangent. After taking X=1, each of the three disjoint reduced blocks is a product of quartic-root sets, with RHS 1, −2, or (−2)^−1. With d=gcd(4,Q−1), taking fourth powers on F_Q^× gives exactly d or zero preimages, hence the extension count 3d²δ. For q≡3,7 mod 8, the quadratic field contains all fourth roots because (q²−1)/4 is a multiple of q−1; the base count is distinguished by the quadratic character of −2. For q≡1 mod 8 it is a square so all roots appear by degree two, with 48 or zero over the base. For q≡5 mod 8 it is a nonsquare, the exponent test in the quadratic field is still the odd multiple (q−1)(q+1)/4 of (q−1)/2, and degree four splits. Thus the first, second and fourth extension counts give the tabulated cycles and closed-point zeta factors. For the rational-prime densities choose β=ζ8·2^(1/4). Eisenstein gives degree four for Q(β); if it contained i it would contain sqrt(2) and ζ8 and equal Q(ζ8), whose real subfield cannot contain 2^(1/4). Hence the splitting field has degree eight with the asserted dihedral presentation and ramifies only over 2 (the binomial discriminant and the roots of unity). Independently enumerating the affine permutation on the paired exponents gives the types with multiplicities 1,3,2,2 in the density order. Chebotarev applies to this rational-prime partition. No twist or excluded-characteristic osculation is being certified.

value.rationale: The locus is natural, but the advertised arithmetic invariant fails the nonmechanical requirement at this scope. The prior integral proof already gives the entire arithmetic input: the three interchangeable pencils each give a copy of the pairs (ζ,b) with ζ⁴=1 and b⁴=−2 over the base. For this product, the proposed extension formula is just the product of the two standard cyclic-group kernel counts; extracting the periods and zeta factors is fixed-point bookkeeping for divisors of four. The densities are likewise fixed once one knows the elementary degree-eight splitting field: the fully split primes have density 1/8 by Chebotarev, and the three residue classes 3,5,7 modulo 8 each have density 1/4, already determining the other three densities from the table. No further sextactic geometry or difficult arithmetic invariant enters. The jet calculation checks that the known binomial scheme really is intrinsic at good primes, by transporting the already known Wronskian factors and controlling the integer scalar; it does not rescue the arithmetic claim or address the bad-characteristic osculation questions left open. This is a scientific rejection of a routine deduction as a finding, not a claim of incorrectness or a rejection for unavailable literature. No distinct supported valuable repair is supplied.
